svg.text: Ghana's digital health: your data's journey

g.text: WARD / OPD
LHIMS / HIMS
orders, vitals,
notes, bills
COMMUNITY
eTracker + mHealth
CWC, ANC, SMS
reminders
DISTRICT
DHIMS2
monthly tallies,
coverage, trends
NATIONAL (GHS / MoH)
policy, vaccines, staffing — from YOUR keystrokes!
wrong tally → wrong vaccines → empty fridge
FLOW: ward LHIMS + community eTracker feed district DHIMS2 → national dashboards →
decisions. One invented CWC tally multiplies into national coverage lies — data quality
is a MORAL act: "if you didn't weigh her, don't tally her."
SYSTEMS TO KNOW: LHIMS (hospital records/orders/billing) · DHIMS2 (aggregate reporting) ·
eTracker (individual longitudinal: ANC, TB, HIV) · mHealth (SMS reminders, MoTeCH, hotlines) ·
telemedicine (doctor-at-distance consults) · paper hybrids (downtime backbones!).
GHANA REALITIES: power cuts (save + charge!), patchy network (sync later, never lose!),
shared computers (log OUT!), low digital literacy (patient teach-back!), language gaps
(audio/visual aids!). Exam favourite: "how do YOU keep data flowing when the light is off?"
— paper backup, batch entry, verify on sync, report gaps honestly.
NURSE'S DATA DUTIES: enter completely + accurately + ON TIME · validate before submit ·
query weird figures (200 ANC visits in a 50-bed week?) · never fabricate · feedback loops:
read YOUR facility's dashboard monthly — trends you see save lives you know.
QUALITY DIMENSIONS (exam list!): accuracy, completeness, timeliness, consistency,
relevance, accessibility, confidentiality. 7 words — memorise as "A nurse's Complete Timely
Consistent Relevant Accessible Confidential record" — AC-TCRAC? Better: "All Care Teams
Create Records Accurately, Completely" — invent YOUR mnemonic and keep it!
POWER LINE: "behind every national health statistic stands a nurse with a pen or phone."
